Dear Koppla Team,

I'm applying for the Product Engineer - Frontend role. I'm a fullstack developer currently completing a vocational AI programming education, with hands-on experience building complete products in TypeScript, React/Next.js on the frontend and FastAPI/Node.js backends.

Building actual, shipped products is what I love. My project TalentHiv (www.talenthiv.com) is a fullstack system where I designed the Next.js/TypeScript frontend, built a structured REST API, modelled the PostgreSQL database with SQLAlchemy, and deployed to Azure App Service and Vercel — the full feature-building process end to end. In VoiceHive Hotels I built an AI voice receptionist with real-time dialogue handling and a cost-conscious, scalable architecture. I work with Tailwind, write clean typed code, and care deeply about the end-user experience, including validation, error handling and testing (Pytest).

Before transitioning to software, I spent 20 years leading 50+ person teams at Casino Cosmopol in a strictly regulated environment — I know what ownership, structure and delivering under responsibility mean in practice.

I'd be excited to grow into a full stack role with you, and I'm a EU citizen open to relocating to Berlin. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
